lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×10

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Commander {AccountData.NickName},

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: did you make it back all right?
Yes, all good.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: This is a small token of my appreciation.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I can't tell you how much I've wanted

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: to talk to someone in person.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: If you spend too much time alone,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: your mind starts to get fuzzy, and you'll gradually have trouble formulating words properly.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Your memory also starts to fail you,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: so I'd find myself forgetting what I did just moments prior.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Most of my days are spent lost in a depressive funk

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but I'm not the only one like this.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: After all, most people living alone experience the same thing.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: When you think about it, humans really are social creatures.
It's still not too late to return now.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: No :/

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It's fine. Really.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: The mood swings always go away eventually.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Like today, I'm in such a great mood because I got to talk your ear off.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Even so, there are still many advantages to living here.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I can devote my entire day to my hobbies.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Whenever I peak my head outside,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I can hear the birds and smell the flowers.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Yet, people living in the Ark can't do any of that.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: So I'm fine.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Really.
If you ever change your mind, just let me know.
There is no further reply.
